name: Rye and Indian Bread
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: good fresh yeast
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of good fresh yeast

instructions.text: Sift the rye and Indian meal
Pour it boiling hot upon the meal
Let it stand till it becomes of only a lukewarm heat
Stir in half a pint of good fresh yeast
Knead the mixture into a stiff dough
Set it to rise in a pan
Cover it with a thick cloth that has been previously warmed, and set it near the fire

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Sift the rye and Indian meal
2. Mix them well together
3. Boil the milk
4. Pour it boiling hot upon the meal
5. Add two tea-spoonfuls of salt
6. Stir the whole very hard
7. Let it stand till it becomes of only a lukewarm heat
8. Stir in half a pint of good fresh yeast
9. Knead the mixture into a stiff dough
10. Set it to rise in a pan
11. Cover it with a thick cloth that has been previously warmed, and set it near the fire
